data.name: RemoteSync_Intro
data.value: Choose how often Agent Studio looks at your pull requests (PR), and in which projects it may do so.

data.name: RemoteSync_Interval_Explanation
data.value: It only counts in the projects with the permission. Without it, Agent Studio does not connect by itself.

data.name: RemoteSync_Projects_None
data.value: No project has the permission. You give it with the switch in the PR section of each project.

data.name: RemoteSync_Sends_Title
data.value: What goes out and what does not

data.name: RemoteSync_Sends_Text
data.value: Each time, Agent Studio asks GitHub how your PRs are doing: their state, reviews and checks. It only reads. It never uploads your code or merges by itself. It does not see or keep your GitHub key either.

data.name: RemoteSync_Publish_Help
data.value: Takes you to the PR section of Repository and changes, with the card to publish this run. Nothing is uploaded until you confirm.

data.name: RemoteSync_Publish_OtherProject
data.value: That run belongs to another project. Open it first and press the button again.

data.name: RemoteSync_Publish_Failed
data.value: The card to publish could not be opened: {0}

data.name: Info_RemoteSync_What
data.value: Agent Studio can look at how your PRs are doing on GitHub every few minutes. It only does so in the projects you allow. Publishing and merging still ask for your permission.

data.name: Info_RemoteSync_Actions
data.value: Choose how often GitHub is looked at. Remove the permission of a project from the list. Give the permission from the PR section of each project. Save so the change applies.
